integrity.heading: Tutoring on DormCheck
integrity.body: Tutoring here means helping someone understand their own work. Doing the work for them is not allowed: no writing or rewriting an assignment that will be turned in as theirs, no sitting an exam, quiz or proctored assessment for anyone, and no selling completed coursework. Posts that offer any of that are removed and the account is reported to the university.
integrity.ack: I understand tutoring means helping someone learn, not doing graded work for them.
